tcg.title: Roronoa Zoro OP15-113 Flagship Battle July 2026 Prize One Piece Japanese No.2
tcg.about: Roronoa Zoro OP15-113, Super Rare (SR) parallel card from the July 2026 Flagship Battle prizes of the Japanese ONE PIECE Card Game, with the alternate art credited to Anderson and the NOT FOR SALE print on the card. Cost 4, 6000 power. The photos show the front, the back and the card in its clear protective film; the corners and edges look clean, with no whitening, folds or dents visible. Offered as a single card.
tcg.why: A Japanese Roronoa Zoro SR parallel card from the 2026 July Flagship Battle prizes.
tcg.perfect: One Piece card collectors who want this card.
